2609.24380.title: Information-Time Proximal Policy Optimization
2609.24380.paper_summary: RLVR has substantially improved the reasoning capabilities of LLMs. However, existing methods typically parameterize temporal progression in the Markov Decision Process by token-by-token generation, despite the highly non-uniform information flow along autoregressive trajectories. In this paper, we propose InfoPPO, which reparameterizes temporal progression using information density rather than raw token count. This reparameterization induces a common state-dependent structure for both temporal credit propagation and policy updates. InfoPPO restores the effectiveness of non-trivial discounting in long-horizon reasoning, retaining effective-horizon contraction while avoiding excessive attenuation of terminal supervision over long token sequences. Moreover, the information-time policy-improvement analysis naturally leads to a state-dependent update constraint, which we implement through adaptive clipping. By adapting the clipping threshold at each token position to the information density of its corresponding state, this mechanism enables more targeted policy updates while preserving proximal control. Theoretically, we extend performance-difference and policy-improvement analyses to the information-time MDP, deriving a policy-improvement lower bound when policy changes are regulated by information density. We further connect the general information-time analysis to practical LLM policy optimization by relating state-wise information density to local policy movement, while also providing theoretical grounding for the adaptive update mechanism. Experiments on Qwen3 models demonstrate consistent gains over competitive baselines across five challenging competition-style mathematical reasoning benchmarks. InfoPPO also maintains stable accuracy and response length across non-trivial discount settings under which token-time PPO deteriorates.
2609.24380.paper_summary_zh: RLVR 顯著提升了 LLM 的推理能力。<lb/>然而，現有方法通常通過逐個生成標記來參數化馬爾可夫決策過程中的時間進展，儘管自回歸軌跡沿途的信息流極不均勻。<lb/>在本文中，我們提出了 InfoPPO，該方法使用信息密度而非原始標記數來重新參數化時間進展。<lb/>這種重新參數化為時間信用傳播和策略更新引入了一種共同的狀態依賴結構。<lb/>InfoPPO 恢復了在長期推理中非平凡折扣的有效性，保持了有效範圍的收縮，同時避免了對長標記序列終端監督的過度衰減。<lb/>此外，信息-時間策略改進分析自然導致了一個狀態依賴的更新約束，我們通過自適應剪裁來實現這一點。<lb/>通過將每個標記位置的剪裁閾值調整為其對應狀態的信息密度，該機制能夠在保持近端控制的同時實現更具針對性的策略更新。<lb/>從理論上講，我們將性能差異和策略改進分析擴展到信息-時間 MDP，推導出當策略變化受到信息密度調控時的策略改進下界。<lb/>我們進一步將一般的信息-時間分析與實際的 LLM 策略優化聯繫起來，通過將狀態的資訊密度與局部策略移動相關聯，同時為自適應更新機制提供理論基礎。<lb/>對 Qwen3 模型的實驗顯示，在五個具有挑戰性的競賽風格數學推理基準上，相較於競爭基準，始終能夠獲得一致的增益。<lb/>InfoPPO 在非平凡折扣設置下也保持了穩定的準確性和響應長度，而在這些設置下，標記-時間 PPO 的表現卻有所下降。
